name: Verify, enrich and score Typeform leads with looot, save them to HubSpot and alert Slack on hot ones

parameters.content:
## Qualify Typeform leads before they reach HubSpot

### How it works
1. Someone submits your Typeform. The workflow finds the email, name and answers by reading the question titles.
2. looot verifies the email. Undeliverable addresses and free mail stop at **Skip**.
3. looot enriches the company from the email domain, and **Score the lead** scores it against your ICP: size, industry, country and email status.
4. Every qualified lead is created or updated in HubSpot. Hot leads (70 or more) also go to Slack.

No AI step: two looot calls per lead. One looot credential replaces the Hunter and AbstractAPI keys this flow usually needs.

**Cost per lead**, from looot's public catalog on 2026-10-31: verify $0.00145, company data $0.0019. About $0.0034 per qualified lead, $0.00145 for one that stops at the email check. Each call is capped at $0.05.

### Setup
- Needs the verified community node **n8n-nodes-looot** (built against 0.1.4): Settings > Community nodes > Install, search `looot`. [Install guide](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/verified-install/)
- looot: sign up at [looot.ai](https://looot.ai), top up (from $5), create an agent token under Settings > Agent tokens, then add a **looot API** credential in n8n.
- Typeform, HubSpot (private app token) and Slack credentials. Set your form in **New Typeform entry** and the channel ID in **Post to Slack**.
- Your form needs an email question.

### Customization
Edit ICP in **Score the lead**. Map more answers to HubSpot fields in **Create or update contact**.

## Check the email first
Undeliverable and free mail stop here.

## Enrich, score, route
Every qualified lead to HubSpot, hot ones to Slack too.
